title: Stop Ruining Your Monday Chest Workout (Form Guide)
hook: Stop destroying your shoulders every Monday with sloppy bench press form.

scenes.text: Stop destroying your shoulders every Monday with sloppy bench press form.
scenes.visual_prompt: cinematic close up of intense muscular athlete lying on bench press gripping loaded barbell, dark gritty gym, dramatic volumetric rim lighting, 8k vertical wallpaper

scenes.text: Most people flare their elbows out at ninety degrees, grinding their delicate rotator cuffs into dust.
scenes.visual_prompt: detailed anatomical view of human shoulder joint and rotator cuff under mechanical stress, glowing red warning energy, hyperrealistic 3d medical render, vertical 9:16

scenes.text: Tuck your elbows to forty-five degrees, retract your shoulder blades, and pin your heels hard into the floor.
scenes.visual_prompt: perfect athletic side view showing 45 degree elbow tuck on heavy barbell press, muscular back arch, powerful form, spotlight focus, 8k vertical

scenes.text: Control the eccentric descent for three full seconds to flood your pecs with pure mechanical tension.
scenes.visual_prompt: heavy Olympic barbell lowering slowly onto chest of powerful athlete with bulging striated pectoral muscles, sweat droplets, extreme macro cinematic 8k vertical

scenes.text: Then explode upward with raw chest contraction. Save this for your Monday workout and tag your gym partner.
scenes.visual_prompt: muscular bodybuilder locking out heavy barbell at top position with triumphant focused expression, chalk cloud in air, dramatic lighting, 8k vertical

cta: Save this for your Monday workout and tag your gym partner.
